preguntas.sql_generada: SELECT a.id_autor, a.nombre, COUNT(l.id_libro) AS num_libros FROM autores a JOIN libros l ON a.id_autor = l.id_autor GROUP BY a.id_autor, a.nombre HAVING COUNT(l.id_libro) > (SELECT AVG(num_libros) FROM (SELECT COUNT(id_libro) AS num_libros FROM libros GROUP BY id_autor) AS avg_libros) ORDER BY num_libros DESC

preguntas.sql_referencia: WITH por_socio AS (SELECT p.id_socio, s.nombre, p.multa, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.id_socio ORDER BY p.multa DESC, p.id_prestamo) AS rn FROM prestamos p JOIN socios s ON s.id_socio = p.id_socio) SELECT id_socio, nombre, multa FROM por_socio WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY id_socio
